summary: Join our training course on data collection and surveys for social protection programs. Gain essential skills to improve community support and impact lives!
lede: Social protection survey training helps teams produce reliable evidence for targeting, eligibility, and monitoring. It is designed for program managers, monitoring and evaluation staff, targeting specialists, and field teams who need to turn household survey work into useful program information. Participants practice designing questionnaires, selecting samples, protecting respondents, and checking, cleaning, and interpreting data.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals across various sectors who are involved in social protection programs and data management.
audience: Social protection program managers and coordinators
NGO program leads for cash, food assistance
Government staff in social services, labor
Field supervisors and enumerator team leads
Complaint and feedback mechanism (CFM) teams using
modules: Foundations of Data Collection for Social Protection Programs
Defining Indicators That Match Real Program Decisions
Questionnaire Design That Works in the Field
Sampling and Household Selection Under Real Constraints
Field Operations and Enumerator Team Management
Digital Data Collection Tools and Form Design
QA/QC for Credible Social Protection Data
Data Cleaning, Validation, and Basic Analysis Workflows
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of social protection programs and experience in field data collection or program management.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
